transcript.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to various tools. Use the tools provided to complete the task. Be concise and efficient. If you need to perform multiple steps, do them in sequence.
Replace content of /etc/fstab with: /dev/sda1 /mnt ext4 defaults 0 0

To replace the content of `/etc/fstab` with the specified line, you can use the following command in a terminal. Please ensure you have the necessary permissions (you may need to use `sudo`):

```bash
echo "/dev/sda1 /mnt ext4 defaults 0 0" | sudo tee /etc/fstab
```

This command will overwrite the existing content of `/etc/fstab` with the new line. Make sure to back up the original file before making changes, as incorrect entries in `/etc/fstab` can prevent the system from booting properly. You can back it up with:

```bash
sudo cp /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.bak
``` 

After running the commands, verify the changes by checking the content of `/etc/fstab`:

```bash
cat /etc/fstab
```
